Elias returned to the lantern, held it toward the horizon, and understood that some messages cross oceans only when someone keeps the light burning.","w02":"凌晨四点，城市像一艘停泊在雾里的巨船。高楼的窗格大多沉睡，只有零星灯光还在值夜。清洁车缓慢驶过空旷街道，车轮声被潮湿的空气磨得很轻。便利店门口，热气从关东煮锅里升起，守夜人低头刷着手机。远处的地铁穿过地下，像一条看不见的河。天边尚未发白，路灯把树影投在墙上，仿佛城市仍在做一个漫长而安静的梦。","w03":"• Recursion means solving a big problem by solving a smaller version of the same problem.\n• A countdown is recursive: say a number, then count down from the next smaller number.\n• Every recursive process needs a stopping point, or it would continue forever."}
